data.description: Why: probe 1 (ideation/agentic-graph-cybernetics/probe-1-runA.md, runB.md) could not tell which agent did anything: the event envelope (Sources/Events/EventEnvelope.swift) carries instance, seq, ts, type, v, workspace, surface, payload and nothing about who. Attribution today runs through free-text tab titles. Deliverable: every surface-scoped event carries agent_type, agent_model and task (the surface metadata keys c11 already holds: terminal_type, model, task, role) as top-level envelope fields, null when unset; docs in skills/c11/references/events.md updated and synced; a test through the real event log path, not source text. Out of scope: any Lattice join logic (LAT-273).
data.title: Agent identity and task id on every c11 event envelope

provenance.reason: Probe 1 ingester spec, agentic-graph / Overwatch dialogue 2026-09-23; Lattice side is LAT-273..282

data.body: Token-accounting slice filed as C11-352 (tab ids in launch records, conversation.bound event, offline c11 usage). It should adopt whatever identity fields this ticket defines. Motivation: 901 launches and about 32.7B tokens in one 5.5-day session could not be attributed to any tab.

Token attribution is item 7 of C11-349: an offline c11 usage command that joins transcripts to panels through the lifecycle journal's existing tab_id and session_id columns, with no new app-side logging. If this ticket lands identity fields on every envelope, c11 usage should prefer them. Motivation: 901 launches and about 32.7B tokens in one 5.5-day session could not be attributed to any panel.
